description: Source code implementing input handling classes for Chromium in Playwright, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen interactions.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input handling for Chromium, including key events and shortcuts.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Handles mouse input events such as move, down, up, wheel, with drag support.

methods.description: Moves mouse cursor, with optional drag handling.
